name: What documents will I need to provide for a remote closing?

mainEntity.name: What documents will I need to provide for a remote closing?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a remote closing, you will typically need to provide identification, financial statements, proof of funds or loan approval letters, and any property-specific disclosures. The exact documents vary based on whether you are buying or selling and the type of property. Your Kelby Contreras remote closing coordinator will provide a comprehensive checklist tailored to your specific transaction early in the process. This preparation ensures that all necessary paperwork is gathered efficiently, preventing last-minute rushes and potential delays, and helps maintain a smooth timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: You'll need identification, financial statements, and property disclosures. Your coordinator will provide a tailored checklist to ensure all documents are gathered efficiently.
